title: impossible-pro-pvp-pack
description: A cursed PvP texture pack that switches around items UI elements and sounds to break your muscle memory and ruin your game sense
body:
this somewhat simple yet impossible to use texture pack, switches around textures to make your pvp experience more... fun.! such as making ender pearls ender eyes and ender eyes ender pearls.

please avoid the use any other 3D weapon texture packs or this one wont work
also avoid any hotbar change, heart change, and hunger change texture packs

RECOMMENDED MINECRAFT VERSIONS: 1.21+


actual changes right here:

release:
diamond armour -> netherite armour
netherite armour -> diamond armour
crosshair not ready -> crosshair charged
crosshair hitable -> crosshair charged
heart -> absorbtion heart
absorbtion heart -> heart
food half -> food full
food full -> food half
hotbar selection -> nothing
armour empty -> armour full
armour full -> armour empty
golden apple -> wind charge
wind charge -> golden apple
diamond chestplate -> elytra
netherite chestplate -> elytra
elytra -> netherite chestplate
diamond sword -> diamond axe
diamond axe -> diamond sword
netherite sword -> netherite axe
netherite axe -> netherite sword
mace -> totem of undying
totem of undying -> mace
ender pearl -> ender eye
ender eye -> ender pearl
critical hit -> nothing

update 1:
all bow charging -> nothing
iron ore -> diamond ore
diamond ore -> iron ore
ancient debris -> netherack
deepslate diamond ore -> deepslate iron ore
deepslate iron ore -> deepslate diamond ore
deepslate emerald ore -> deepslate side
nether portal -> nothing
all air bubble textures

SOUNDS

all critical hits, swing hits, strong attacks -> nothing
